heading: Writing
description: Twenty essays over twelve months, written without AI, each graded before publication against a standard that rewards real thinking over polish. Taking positions, citing sources, naming what changed.
lede: Twenty essays over twelve months, written without AI, each graded before publication against a standard that asks one question: did writing this concentrate my understanding into something I did not have before I started? Take a position; cite the source; name what changed your mind.
body: The first essay should go up by July 31.
